'''Shoola's Ring''' was a location in [[Port Tooga]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Listehol system/Legends|Listehol system]] controlled by [[Shoola]]. It was the main passage to the [[Barvy Harpy]], [[Biscuit Barren]] and the [[Nova Room]].
